candidates.headline: Steelers' Keeanu Benton agrees to 4-year, $72M extension, sources say
candidates.description: The Steelers and defensive tackle Keeanu Benton agreed to a four-year, $72 million extension, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport on Friday night.

candidates.headline: Sources: Cardinals OL Bisontis' season in doubt with torn MCL
candidates.description: Chase Bisontis, the Cardinals' second-round pick who was expected to push starter Isaiah Adams for playing time, could miss the season after tearing his left MCL in Thursday night's preseason game, sources told NFL Network.
